title: Money on the Medical Plan Bill Set Against a Closing Rider Figure
content:
Money left standing on a member's Medicare Advantage Health Plans bill may be set against what would otherwise be left owed on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders as it closes.

## The rule

1. Where the money left standing on the medical plan bill comes to more than what would otherwise be left owed, the amount set against it is what would otherwise be left owed.
2. Where that bill carries money received against it and the money left standing on it does not come to more than that, the amount set against it is the whole of the money left standing on the medical plan bill.
3. Otherwise the amount set against it is nothing, no money having been received on the medical plan bill.

## The two quantities

**What would otherwise be left owed** is what stands owed on the rider less the rider premium refunded, rounded to the nearest cent and never less than nothing.

**The money left standing on the medical plan bill** is what has been paid on that Medicare Advantage Health Plans enrollment's premium account less the medical plan premium charged on it, and is never less than nothing.

## Condition and amount set off

| Money left standing on the medical plan bill | Money received on that bill | The amount set against the closing figure |
|---|---|---|
| More than what would otherwise be left owed | Either | What would otherwise be left owed |
| Not more than that | Yes | The whole of the money left standing on the bill |
| Not more than that | No | Nothing |

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

Take what would otherwise be left owed of 111.00 USD.

- Money left standing of 200.00 USD: that comes to more, so 111.00 USD is set against it, and nothing is left owed.
- Money left standing of 45.00 USD, the bill carrying money received against it: the whole 45.00 USD is set against it, leaving 66.00 USD owed.
- Money left standing of 111.00 USD, the bill carrying money received against it: it does not come to more, so the whole 111.00 USD is set against it, and nothing is left owed.
- Money left standing of nothing, the bill carrying no money received against it: nothing is set against it, and 111.00 USD is left owed.
